people.name: Sanjay Banga
people.role: Additional Director and CEO Designate from November 11, 2026; CEO & MD from May 1, 2027
people.bio: Mr. Sanjay Banga is the Chief Executive Officer and Managing Director of Tata Power Renewable Energy Limited and currently holds the position of President – Renewables of The Tata Power Company Limited. Previously served as President of the Transmission and Distribution businesses and Chief Executive Officer of Tata Power Delhi Distribution Limited. More than three decades of experience. Alumnus of the National Institute of Technology, Kurukshetra, holds an MBA from the Faculty of Management Studies, University of Delhi, and completed the Senior Executive Leadership Program at Harvard Business School.
